core_meaning.primary_meaning: Moutasim is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who holds fast, clings firmly”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Moutasim corresponds to the Arabic form معتصم (Arabic root ع ص م (ʿ-ṣ-m); مُعْتَصِم (Muʿtaṣim)). Its core sense is one who holds fast, clings firmly. Moutasim is Arabic مُعْتَصِم (Muʿtaṣim) 'one who holds fast, clings firmly', from the root ع ص م (ʿ-ṣ-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave موتسيم (a non-standard form); the correct form is مُعْتَصِم. The source gloss 'Agrees, accepts' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as motasim.
